response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong full-stack and distributed systems expertise with exposure to event-driven architectures and AI-agent tooling, but lacks explicit experience in executive leadership, fintech infrastructure, or regulated AI systems at scale. His background is more aligned with hands-on engineering than CTO-level strategic and organizational responsibilities.
strengths: Proven experience with event-driven architectures and distributed systems, including high-throughput microservices and real-time data processing.
Hands-on contributions to AI-agent infrastructure (e.g., MCP code generators) and open-source tooling, indicating familiarity with agentic workflows.
Diverse technical background spanning backend, frontend, and embedded systems, with a focus on testability and developer tooling.
concerns: No explicit experience in executive leadership or scaling engineering teams from 10 to 30+ people, a hard requirement for the role.
Lacks demonstrated production experience with multi-agent AI systems in regulated or high-stakes environments (e.g., fintech, credit risk).
Fintech-specific expertise (e.g., credit systems, payment flows) is limited and not highlighted as a core competency.
